name: create_project_env
description:
Create one or more environment variables for a project, each with a key, value, type, and target environments. If upsert is "true", an existing variable with the same key has its value updated instead of a new one being created.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel --scope {teamSlugOrId} env add {name} {environment} --project {projectIdOrName}. Fill placeholders from inputs.

idOrName.description: The unique project identifier or the project name

comment.description: A comment to add context on what this environment variable is for

customEnvironmentIds.description: The custom environment IDs associated with the environment variable

anyOf.description: If defined, the git branch of the environment variable (must have target=preview)

target.description: The target environment of the environment variable
